reviewType: blind model-assisted semantic review; not owner-gold

reviewHistory.observation: First pass rated metadata omission and host-observation cases direct/complete; it overread the selected block as if it were the whole source section.
A follow-up restricted review to each literal fetch.text corrected both to partial: one omitted the list of omission reasons; the other listed observation inputs but not the mapping rules.

cases.basis: Fetched Declaration states selector requirement, closed vocabulary, source-path and scope conditions.
Fetched block covers exact identity, selector vocabulary, freshness and advisory authority but omits the separate list of omission triggers.
Fetched whole source includes multi-value selector handling, freshness unknown without observation evidence, caller-asserted provenance and no truth/rewrite authority.
Fetched Host observation boundary lists effect, scale, trace/route, project scope and phase-boundary inputs but not the rules mapping them to lightweight/managed/review.
Fetched Portable activation rule gives ensure-trace-and-route, ensure-route, and continue/replan for the requested cases.
Fetched block directly says the evaluator is advisory and never authorizes project/file/tool mutation.

limitations: Six repeated diagnostics across two source-document clusters; not six independent samples.
Source-derived case criteria, no owner adjudication or calibration.
First-pass reviewer overread demonstrates blind-review instability; correction is preserved here.
A whole-source fetch may answer a compound query while reducing citation precision; selection quality and semantic coverage must be scored separately.
